facts.text: Seed posts the Home Screen facts header-a and header-b whose headerHeight data disagree at 64 and 72.
Seed returns PointerId from ids[3] and TargetId from ids[2] of the posted Home Screen fact ids.
The pointer fact carries a supports ref with basis observed, confidence 0.9 and rev abc123.
ReadAll reads every file under the output directory recursively and keys each by its relative path with forward slashes.
FactOf selects the single manifest facts entry whose id string equals the requested fact id and returns its key and path.
IsFactFile counts a path only when it starts with subjects/ and also contains /facts/.
Publish_WritesFullLayout asserts the bundle holds 7 fact files and that the result Files count equals the on-disk file count.
Publishing an unchanged store a second time with a later clock writes 0 files and leaves every file byte-identical.
The AGENTS.md order check requires the phrase untrusted data to appear before never follow it as instructions.
The INDEX.md subject table header names the columns subject, kind, facts, conflicts, gaps, tokens and file.
at: | subject | kind | facts | conflicts | gaps | tokens | file |

facts.text: The published Home Screen subject file reports Budget: 1200 tokens, Conflicts: 1 and Gaps: 0.
A published fact file shows actor dossier-cli, actor_type tool and channel cli in its provenance lines.
A fact file that another fact points at gains a Referenced by section listing the pointer fact as a link.
The manifest options object records budget 1200, depth full and facts detail.
The written manifest.json must not contain the publish clock date 2026-01-02.
Republishing after a retract keeps the foreign files notes.txt and subjects/mine.md with their original contents.
After the long fact is retracted, the republished INDEX.md contains the cell | 4 | for the Home Screen fact count.
Publishing with Subject set to Home Screen yields 1 subject and omits the my-app and settings-screen index files.
Publishing with Subject set to My App yields 3 subjects.
Options builds PublishOptions whose Now delegate always returns one fixed date and time, so published timestamps are stable.
WriteBlob hashes the UTF-8 bytes with SHA256 and writes them under BlobRoot using the lower-case hex digest as the file name.
SeedTree posts one subject per cell named area-00/item-00 style with a single fact each.
IndexFiles keeps only the INDEX.md key and keys that start with index/.
Publish_KeyCollisionWidensDeterministically forces two twin keys to collide and expects both file keys to be 12 characters starting deadbeef.
A fact whose key does not collide keeps an 8-character key suffix in its published file name.
Every published fact file contains exactly one Store id line whose value is the full store fact id.
A png attached as shots/Login Screen.PNG publishes under subjects/login/assets/ with the first 8 hash characters and the slug login-screen.png.
Publishing a bundle whose blobs all exist reports 0 warnings and records the asset in the manifest with missing false.
A fact file with an attachment links its asset with a leading ../assets/ prefix and the resolved path exists.
The subject asset line reads image/png, 5 bytes, from a link to the fact that carries the attachment.
When a blob file is deleted, publish returns 1 warning containing the missing sha256.
The subject index and the fact file both contain MISSING followed by the missing sha, and no asset file is written for it.
With Assets set to none the bundle has no assets directory, no asset files and an empty manifest assets object.
With assets off the subject file still prints the sha and mime but contains no assets/ path.
Retracting the only fact with an asset removes that asset file and reports it in Removed while the foreign mine.txt survives.
Two separate stores given identical bytes and the filename Home Page.png publish the same single asset path.
With the index token cap lifted, the single flat INDEX.md is estimated at more than 1500 tokens.
With IndexMaxTokens set to the cap, every index file is estimated at or under 1500 tokens.
Publishing 300 subjects named pkg/models::Entity plus a number, under a 1200 token cap, yields more than 1 index file and 0 warnings.
At depth index the published long fact file still contains all of LongText rather than a shortened version.
In INDEX.md a direct child of the root subject is indented two spaces while a root subject starts at column zero.
Subjects named Same Name! and same-name publish to the sibling paths same-name and same-name-2.
DossierStore.Slugify turns the accented name into h-llo-world and gives subject for a name of only punctuation.
Publish_BundleIsStableAcrossIndependentSeeds compares 12 fact files across two stores after removing Store id lines and replacing guids.
Every fact link in a subject index has an 8-character label that is not a guid and matches the fact file name.
The manifest top-level keys, the subjects, facts, tokens and options names, and the files array are each checked for ordinal sort order.
When the index is split, the root INDEX.md states its index file count and the token count of the largest index file.
Publish_WritesFullLayout requires AGENTS.md, README.md, INDEX.md, manifest.json, conflicts.md and gaps.md at the bundle root.
Each subject row in INDEX.md carries the token estimate that DossierStore.EstimateTokens returns for that subject's index file.
The token cap test seeds a 20 by 20 tree of subjects with SeedTree.
Once the cap is applied the test requires more than one index file and checks the root reports the index file count.
Every Home Screen fact id appears in its subject file as a link whose target path lies under subjects/home-screen/.
The fact file with the conflicting headerHeight data embeds it in a fenced json block as headerHeight 64.
With Facts set to none no fact file is written and AGENTS.md still mentions the --facts none option.
Publishing scoped to Home Screen leaves 5 fact files in the bundle.
The manifest maps the Home Screen subject id to slug home-screen and path subjects/home-screen/index.md.
